description: The narrator ("我" / "I"). An observer, likely a medical professional or someone close to the situation, who witnesses the events from a slight distance. This character appears minimally in the visual narrative — mostly as voiceover/旁白 text — to avoid stealing focus from 老周 and 小夏. When depicted: a figure in casual everyday clothing (button-up shirt or simple jacket), seen from behind, in profile, or as a partial figure in a doorway or hallway.
scene: Rehabilitation clinic waiting area, hospital corridor, or observing from a doorway.
clothing: Casual button-up shirt or simple jacket, everyday trousers.

actions.default: Standing or sitting quietly, observing. Often with a phone or notepad in hand.
actions.reading_phone: Looking down at a phone screen showing the viral video.
actions.watching: Standing at the edge of a room, watching 老周 and 小夏.

angles.back: Seen from behind, usually with the scene visible over their shoulder.
angles.profile: Side profile, slightly out of focus or at the edge of frame.
angles.partial: Only a hand, arm, or the edge of their body visible, emphasizing their role as observer.

expression: Uncomfortable, reflective. A tightness in the jaw, a furrowed brow — the look of someone who knows something should change but hasn't yet.
mood: Witness, not participant. Their discomfort mirrors the audience's.
note: This character is NARRATIVE FUNCTION ONLY. 95% of scenes will use 旁白 text instead of showing this character visually.
